$comment: Mission 1.80. Which held subject, if any, is the candidate for SROS's second Opportunity exploration. A read-only comparison over the current preparation record and the deployment; ordinal fields only; nothing canonical moved, no model, no egress decision. Authoritative where paired with the generated Markdown; the gate recomputes every per-candidate fact from the preparation and reconciliation records and the reviewed scope rules.

measured_from.preparation_current: re-run through the canonical runner and --check current
measured_from.database: live, read only: 177 held division-92 notices and 11 held division-90 notices inspected for their CPV class codes

selection_basis: no candidate passes every load-bearing gate: the only frontier candidate, ted-eu:CPV-division:92, is the best held evidence packet and is a CATEGORY whose held cohorts span at least six distinct CPV classes, so a hypothesis at its grain would be a disjunction of unrelated service markets and no product intervention is grounded; every other candidate is vetoed
why_they_differ: the richest held packet is a procurement category, and a category of film production, sports-facility operation, museum, artistic and news-agency services is not one market. Selecting it for its evidence would relocate the subject into a disjunction of its members, which is the shape Mission 1.47 refused for a proposition and applies to a subject just the same.

candidate_universe.built_from: every packet in the current preparation record other than the one holding the current Opportunity's cited rows
candidate_universe.identity_rule: the repository's own grouping (source-native-subject-grouping@1.2.0 over canonical-subject-registry@1.1.0); nothing merged, nothing inferred; SAME_PROBLEM_FAMILY stays PARKED

ordinal_rules.scorable_breadth: scorable rows 0 LOW, 1 to 9 MEDIUM, >= 10 HIGH
ordinal_rules.counting_dimension_diversity: counting dimensions 0 or 1 LOW, 2 MEDIUM, >= 3 HIGH
ordinal_rules.independence: UNKNOWN on every row with 0 groups is UNKNOWN; never ESTABLISHED without a group
ordinal_rules.semantic_specificity: PRODUCT and GEOGRAPHY subjects HIGH; CATEGORY, TOPIC and UNDETERMINED LOW
ordinal_rules.commercial_information: NONE without a commercial counting dimension; LOW with one on fewer than 3 scorable rows; MEDIUM with one on 3 or more scorable rows; HIGH is reserved for WILLINGNESS_TO_PAY, which no held row carries
ordinal_rules.problem_information: NONE without PROBLEM_OR_NEED, SOLUTION_GAP or SOLUTION_DISSATISFACTION
ordinal_rules.governance_distance_to_synthesis: NONE when every source in the packet is egress eligible; LOW when one open question blocks it; HIGH when a review was refused
ordinal_rules.new_acquisition_required: NO when the packet is formable from held data

candidates.subject_scope_basis: reviewed scope rule for ted-eu (SOURCE_NATIVE): a CPV division is a top-level division of the Common Procurement Vocabulary
candidates.provenance_note: one publisher, one resource, one collector route; 8 Claims, each with one support group of UNKNOWN provenance
candidates.egress_reason: ted-eu external_model_transmission is NOT_ASSESSED under local-private-research-v1 (H-39): an open question an operator can close, not a prohibition
candidates.representation_note: the bounded payload (packet id, subject, procedures, families, dimensions, independence sentence, 8 composed Claim statements, evidence ids) passes check_representation with 0 violations, 4378 characters, no notice payload, no personal data; assembled in memory and not sent
candidates.establishes: TED published, in its eforms contract-and-award resource, bounded sets of CONTRACT_NOTICE and CONTRACT_AWARD_NOTICE notices classified under CPV division 92 whose stated TOTAL_VALUE amounts at notice scope differ from one another (contrasts of 86,897,500 EUR; 16,581,256 EUR; 14,695,337 EUR; 1,774,223.99 EUR; 15,000,000 SEK); contracting authorities exist in this category; classified procurement activity exists
candidates.does_not_establish: actual expenditure (BT-161 includes options and renewals and may never be exercised); willingness to pay for any proposed product; market size; product demand; a buyer for an unspecified future SaaS; addressable revenue; unmet need; dissatisfaction; a solution gap; which of the six-plus service classes any of it concerns

held_class_distribution.note: codes read from held normalized records; labels are the CPV vocabulary's own class names as this repository's earlier missions recorded them, cited for orientation and not as a subject

candidates.what_a_synthesis_could_say: that EU contracting authorities publish procurement in recreational, cultural and sporting services with widely differing notice values, i.e. an active commercial category with buyers who publish what they buy
candidates.what_it_could_not_say: what is bought, by whom, for what need, whether any of it is underserved, or which service market a product would enter; the hypothesis would name a disjunction of film, sports, museum, artistic and news-agency services
candidates.product_decision_it_could_inform: whether public-procurement-facing products are worth researching at all, and in which class; nothing narrower
current_blockers: CATEGORY grain spanning at least six CPV classes; no product intervention grounded at division grain
ted-eu egress NOT_ASSESSED (an operator decision, recorded here and not taken)
narrowing to CPV-class grain needs a class-grain cohort derivation and a grouping rule, which the extractor and grouping procedures do not have today (held data only, no acquisition)
candidates.veto_reason: its only product relevance at the current grain requires unsupported semantic invention: a narrower problem or product would have to be named for the hypothesis to be actionable, and naming one is exactly what section 9 forbids

exploratory_category_hypothesis.why_not: an exploratory hypothesis at division grain would read 'EU contracting authorities buy recreational, cultural and sporting services at widely differing values', which names no need, no buyer type, no product and no class; the six-plus held classes share nothing but a filing prefix, so the hypothesis would be a disjunction of unrelated service markets, the shape Mission 1.47 refused for a proposition

dominance.rule: X dominates Y when X is at least as good on every dominance field and strictly better on at least one; dominance is a veto on the dominated candidate, never a selection rule, and section 19's vetoes are applied independently of it
dominance.frontier_note: kubernetes and podman sit on the frontier because they name a product and division 92 names a category; semantic specificity is a dominance field, so the richer packet does not dominate them. Both are vetoed on formability, which is the gate a frontier place does not waive. The frontier is what the stated rule produces, not what the author first wrote: the first draft listed both as dominated by division 92.

load_bearing_gates.actionable_grain: none: both TED packets are REQUIRES_NARROWER_SUBJECT_DISCOVERY, every other candidate NOT_ACTIONABLE
load_bearing_gates.why_no_selection: a candidate passes only if it clears every gate, and actionable grain is a gate; selecting the richest packet regardless would optimise for Opportunity count, which section 22 forbids

narrowing.why_narrowing_is_possible_from_held_data: the 177 held division-92 notices carry their CPV class codes on every record: at least six classes with seven or more notices each (motion picture and video services, sports facility operation, museum services, news agency services, artistic services, sound technician services); a class-grain cohort is a re-derivation over held NormalizedRecords, not an acquisition
narrowing.what_narrowing_requires: a class-grain cohort derivation (the procurement-value-contrast extractor groups by division), a class-grain subject key in the grouping procedure, currency-pure cohorts as Mission 1.41 requires, and a re-run of the preparation runner; the two reviewed TED reliability scopes carry no classification division and would bind unchanged (Mission 1.40, 1.42)
narrowing.what_narrowing_does_not_change: procurement semantics (a notice value is not spend and not willingness to pay), the egress question, independence (one publisher), or the profile's calibration

egress.why_selection_does_not_need_it: permission to send a bounded representation to a model and evidence sufficiency are separate questions; a candidate is selected on its evidence and blocked on its egress

recommended_next_mission.title: Procurement Subject-Grain Narrowing V1
recommended_next_mission.shape: held data only: derive CPV-class-grain cohorts from the held division-92 NormalizedRecords, define class-grain subject keys in the grouping procedure, re-run the preparation runner, and re-select among the class-grain packets against the same gates; no acquisition, no model, no egress decision, no Opportunity

representation_check.note: section 17: representation feasibility is tested deterministically without egress; a constructible payload is not permission to send it
